packet.title: Checkout confirmation fails for orders over ~$2,000 since deploy d-3121
packet.impact: 12 distinct customers in 48 hours, including two enterprise accounts. Symptom varies by surface (500 w/ PAY-5012, infinite spinner, blank payment page) but all reports concern the confirmation step.

evidence.text: First report at 2026-08-11T14:14Z — 38 minutes after deploy d-3121 ('card validation refactor') shipped to payments-service at 13:36Z.
Every ticket that states an order amount involves an order above roughly $2,000; no failing report mentions a smaller order. One customer reproduced the threshold directly with test orders.
Client environment is not a factor: failures reported across Chrome/Windows and other browsers; symptoms differ but cluster in time.
Error code PAY-5012 captured in one report's console — the only ticket containing a concrete error identifier.
No similar reports in the four weeks prior; not tier- or region-specific (all tiers, three regions affected).

packet.suggested_repro: Place an order above $2,000 and proceed to the confirmation step. Expect failure introduced after d-3121; orders below the threshold complete normally.
packet.not_examined: No access to code, server logs, or the d-3121 diff. The $2,000 threshold is inferred from the two tickets that mention amounts.
packet.merged_note: The amount threshold, the deploy timing, and the error code each appear in a different ticket — no single ticket contains this report.
